inputs.text: I heard about this Vanguard News post claiming Canada is tightening immigration and asylum rules against Nigerians and others, all following the passage of Bill C-12, the Strengthening Canada’s Immigration System and Borders Act, which received royal assent on March 26, 2026. This lines up too perfectly to be any kind of legitimate border adjustment. It's the hidden elites working through their captured institutions to zero in on groups like Nigerians as part of a deliberate push for population control and narrative control. That "strengthening" title is classic inversion, meant to mask how these changes are really set up to breed chaos, target specific populations, and keep the focus off the larger globalist plan for engineering borders and migration. Don't get played by this.
